title: India IIP by use-based category (MoSPI)
description: Index of Industrial Production, general and the six use-based categories (primary, capital, intermediate, infrastructure and construction goods, consumer durables, consumer non-durables), 2022-23 base: latest month y/y as published by MoSPI; 3mma (m3): plain average of the latest three months' published y/y; and the calendar year to date (January to the latest month) average index against the same months a year earlier, calculated. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/iip/in_iip_usebased.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly IIP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
